evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: A decision harness poses the agent's recurring judgements as closed questions at 13 decision points and acts only through fixed messages that never contain an answer, so any model that answers the questions can serve as the judge.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Retraining on labels from task construction, verifiers or execution raised decision accuracy on every question in each of three trained versions, and a new version enters service only through a promotion gate.
